title: Macklemore hits back with 'Free Palestine Tour' after Ed Sheeran split

blocks.text: United States rapper Macklemore, who was dropped from British pop star Ed Sheeran’s tour after making pro-Palestinian comments, announced Thursday, Sept. 24, he will instead perform on his own “Free Palestine Tour.” Macklemore, who was opening for Sheeran’s “Loop Tour,” shouted “Free Palestine!” and told Palestinians they were “not forgotten” during two concerts earlier this month in New Jersey. The “Thrift Shop” star was quickly booted from the US tour — a decision that Sheeran said was made by tour promoters, not him — provoking outrage among musicians and pro-Palestinian activists. “What happened to me is bigger than one artist or […]...
